name: ES-CL Overlap Session Correlation
description: Rolling 60-bar Pearson correlation between ES and CL 5-min returns during the US/EU overlap session (8:00-11:30 ET). Outputs: correlation time series with zero reference, histogram of session-end readings, summary stats (N, median, hit rate positive, extremes), and event markers for correlation breakdowns (crosses below zero).
source:
# ES-CL Rolling Correlation During US/EU Overlap (8:00-11:30 ET)
# 60-bar Pearson on 5-min returns — captures ~5 hours of co-movement
# Primary asset: ES (market_data_source), Reference: CL (reference_futures)

# --- Data: ES (primary) ---
es_raw = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
es_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(es_raw.o, es_raw.h, es_raw.l, es_raw.c, es_raw.v, es_raw.oi, es_raw.s)

# --- Data: CL (reference) ---
cl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(cl_raw.o, cl_raw.h, cl_raw.l, cl_raw.c, cl_raw.v, cl_raw.oi, cl_raw.s)

# --- Returns (close-to-close on 5-min bars) ---
es_ret = returns(period=1)(es_cont.c)
cl_ret = returns(period=1)(ffill(cl_cont.c))

# --- Session window: US/EU overlap 8:00-11:30 ET ---
overlap = session_window(
    session=Session(start='08:00', end='11:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(es_cont.o, es_cont.h, es_cont.l, es_cont.c)

# --- Rolling correlation (60-bar Pearson) ---
corr_60 = rolling_corr(window=60, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(es_ret, cl_ret)

# --- Session-filtered correlation: only during overlap window ---
# Use overlap.active to isolate the session, overlap.closed for end-of-session snapshot
overlap_corr = where(overlap.active, corr_60)
eod_corr = where(overlap.closed and overlap.opened, corr_60)

# --- Detect correlation breakdowns: crosses below zero during session ---
corr_prev = corr_60 >> 1
corr_crossed_below = (is_valid(corr_prev) and corr_prev >= 0.0) and corr_60 < 0.0
corr_breakdown = overlap.active and corr_crossed_below
corr_at_breakdown = where(corr_breakdown, corr_prev)
es_price_at_breakdown = where(corr_breakdown, es_cont.c)

# --- Timestamp for x-axis ---
ts = index()()

# --- Output 1: Rolling correlation time series (session-filtered) ---
xy_lines(
    title='ES-CL Correlation During US/EU Overlap (8:00-11:30 ET)',
    category='ES-CL Overlap Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Pearson Correlation',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Bar Rolling Corr', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Moderate (+0.5)')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-1.0, to=0.0, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.05, label='Negative')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=overlap_corr)

# --- Output 2: Histogram of session-end correlation readings ---
# Use eod_corr (sparse, not ffill'd) per S48 to avoid stat distortion
histogram(
    title='How Often Is ES-CL Correlated During the Overlap?',
    category='ES-CL Overlap Correlation',
    bins=25,
    x_axis_label='Session-End Correlation',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    x_axis_dp=2,
    order=2
)(eod_corr)

# --- Output 3: Summary stats table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='ES-CL Overlap Correlation',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Session-End Correlation Statistics',
        row_size=3, col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Central Tendency', 'Extremes', 'Regime'],
        col_headers=['Metric', 'Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Number of overlap sessions'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Median session-end correlation'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Worst session-end correlation'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Best session-end correlation'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Mean session-end correlation'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Std dev of session-end correlation')
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(eod_corr, eod_corr, eod_corr, eod_corr, eod_corr, eod_corr)

# --- Event markers: correlation breakdown (crosses below zero) ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Correlation Breakdown',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Prior Corr', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='ES Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(corr_at_breakdown, es_price_at_breakdown, corr_breakdown)
